purpose: Reinstated shared data contract (a previously frozen conclusion that was silently dropped). Every arm MUST see identical inputs, blocks, splits, folds, and traits; otherwise the compression comparison is not attributable.

shared_snp_set.coordinate_rule: exact CHROM:POS:REF:ALT; duplicate-position groups removed; 22<->chr22 alias only
shared_snp_set.must_not: adjust MAF or truncate to hit a power of two or the SNPBag 81920

block_version.definition: LD blocks over the frozen chr22 panel
block_version.must_be: identical block boundaries and identical block version id across all arms
block_version.binding: block version id and its hash to be fixed at run-authorization time

split.cv: outer 5-fold nested CV drawn once and shared byte-identically across all arms and all k
split.hgdp: forbidden for this experiment (decision holdout untouched)

trait_panel.kind: simulated (no real phenotypes exist for this panel)
trait_panel.shared: identical simulated trait matrix across all arms; arms differ only in the representation, never in the labels or folds

binding_status.note: these hashes are intentionally unbound in this design-only package; binding them is a pre-run gate

real_data_extension.requires: a new prospective data contract for an external panel with real phenotypes (e.g. a biobank); not authorized by this package
